tagline: Curious mind, compassionate coach, love‑in‑the‑lab partner
summary: When Adam isn’t lecturing at Wharton or penning best‑sellers, he’s the guy who jumps back on a diving board after decades to prove growth is a lifelong habit. He thrives on tough‑love conversations that blend research with real‑world empathy, and he spends his free moments mapping out connections on his VIBE tour with friends like Jennifer Garner. Behind the polished podcasts, he’s a relentless experimenter in relationships, always testing how kindness and curiosity can reshape habits.
